sections.section_title: LTDC layer 1 auxiliary frame buffer address 1 register (LTDC_L1AFBA1R)
sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.40 "LTDC layer 1 auxiliary frame buffer address 1 register (LTDC_L1AFBA1R)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2144.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x144
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register defines the start address for the auxiliary 1 frame buffer. It has to point to the
address where the pixel data of the top left pixel of a layer is stored in the frame buffer
(theauxiliary 0 and 1 frame buffers are for YCbCr semi-planar or full-planar pixel formats).
Bits 31:0 AFBADD1[31:0]: Auxiliary frame buffer start address
This bitfield defines the color frame buffer start address.
